Mohammad Firas Sada

Research Networking Systems Engineer at ESnet · Energy Sciences Network · LBNL

I'm a research networking systems engineer at ESnet, working remotely. Software-defined networks and transfer tooling that keep high-energy physics data moving at petabyte scale.

Currently: ESnet (remote) · just published PEARC '26 · teaching the NRP on the side

Selected work

Jupyter-Agent

Gives plain JupyterHub Coder-class features: SSH into pods over HTTPS, subdomain port-forwarding, one-click VS Code. All extension points, no core changes.

JupyterCluster

Multi-hub management for JupyterHub on Kubernetes: a hub that provisions many JupyterHub releases in separate namespaces, with RBAC and a REST API.

llms-or-naive-bayes

Reproduction artifact for PEARC '26: Naive Bayes vs LLMs across 4 families and a 37x scale range, with a Helm model-selection operator.

nrp-header-collection

Minimal sFlow collector for Kubernetes. UDP/6343 behind a ClusterIP service, JSON or PCAP, self-tested with a synthetic packet.
